GET /nsi/api/search/fres
Parameters:

Added: pcepManagementType in query

(Optional) Filter SR Policies FRE with pcepManagementType. Possible values ["NA", "PCE-Initiated", "PCC-Delegated"]

Added: namedQueryParam2 in query

(Optional) can be used with namedQuery fresWithSupportedPWModes in format ncId:pwMode

Added: endpoint.tpe.shelfNetworkConstruct in query

Comma separated Shelf Network Construct identifier

Changed: layerRate in query

FRE layer rates in comma separated list. NA results in all Fres with no layerRate. NOT query is supported. The allowed layerRate values are: ETHERNET, OTU1, OTU2, OTU2e, OTU3, OTU4, OTUCn, OTSi, OMS, OS, PHY, OTS, FICON, FC, ODU, ODU0, ODU1, ODU2, ODU2e, ODU3, ODU4, ODUCn, DSR, DSR_10GE, DSR_100GE, DSR_ETHERNET, ENCAPSULATION, MPLS, MPLS_PROTECTION, MEDIA, LAG, RS, E1, E3, E1_2M, EC1, DSR_2M, LINE_OC3_STS3_AND_MS_STM1, SECTION_OC3_STS3_AND_RS_STM1, DSR_OC3_STM1, DSR_OC12_STM4, LINE_OC12_STS12_AND_MS_STM4, SECTION_OC12_STS12_AND_RS_STM4, LINE_OC48_STS48_AND_MS_STM16, SECTION_OC48_STS48_AND_RS_STM16, DSR_OC48_STM16, DSR_OC192_STM64, CES_IWF, T1, DSR_1_5M, STS1, STS3C, STS12C, STS24C, STS48C, STS192C, DS0, DS1, DS3, VT15, VT2, NOT_APPLICABLE, ODUFLEX, OTUg, ODUg, BGP, FLEXE_GROUP, IP, CBR, DSR_FLEXI, XGTC, STS1_50M, DSR_50M, VC4C, VC4_4C, VC4_16C, Flex

Changed: serviceClass in query

(Optional) Allow filtering on the FRE service class. This parameter accepts a list of comma separated values. NA results in all Fres with no serviceClass. NOT query is supported. LLDP, ROADM Line and Fiber has been deprecated. The allowed serviceClass values are: EVC, ETransit, EAccess, VLAN, TDM, Pseudowire Link, Transport Client, Photonic, Tunnel, IP, LLDP, Ethernet, DSR Ethernet, LAG, OTU, OMS, OTS, SNC , OSRP Link, OSRP Line, SNCP, ICL, Ring, FlexeLink, FlexeGroup, OTSi, MEDIA, FlexE, L3VPN, BGP Session, Path, EVPN VPWS, PON Link, EVPN VPWS FXC, ODU, Physical,PROTECTED_OMS

Changed: supportedByFreId in query

(Optional) Retrieves all supported parent FREs (default is one serviceClass/layer level up) that have a serviceClass designation for the specified list of FRE Id

Changed: namedQuery in query

(Optional) Comma-separated named query id list; The allowed values are: resiliency, tdmServices, topologicalLinks, roadmLineSpan, reusableSNCG, reusableMRSNCG, reusableNMRSNCG, tunnelReplacement, layer1OtuLinks, photonicSncpWorkLegs, relatedFresFull, relatedFresLight, ringsWithoutConstraints, groupedSNCDTLSET, relatedRoadmlineSeedsForIntent, fresWithSrlg, l1LinkFresForHomeRoute, l1NcpTransportServices, resiliencyFre,staticRouteL3VPN, l1NcpLinkFres, virtualRingsOnL2Motr, fresWithSupportedPWModes, ebgpL3VPN, layer1LinkConstraints, physicalLinkFres, fresWithTimeAwareSrlg,fresByNcPairs,supportedProtectionFres

tunnelReplacement cannot be used in combination with other named queries

virtualRingsOnL2Motr can not be used alone, networkConstruct.Id must be provided with this named query

fresWithSupportedPWModes can be combined with namedQueryParam1 or namedQueryParam2 or both

photonicSncpWorkLegs can not be used alone, networkConstruct.Id must be provided with this named query

relatedFresFull can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

relatedFresLight can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

relatedRoadmlineSeedsForIntent can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query

l1LinkFresForHomeRoute can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query

resiliencyFre can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query

groupedSNCDTLSET cannot be used in combination with other named queries and can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

staticRouteL3VPN can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

l1NcpLinkFres can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

ebgpL3VPN can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

physicalLinkFres can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

fresByNcPairs can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named Query. Provide namedQueryParam1 like {neName1&neName2},{neName3&neName4}...

supportedProtectionFres can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named Query. Provide namedQueryParam1 like {id}...

Changed: namedQueryParam1 in query

Mandatory when namedQuery relatedFresFull/relatedFresLight/relatedRoadmlineSeedsForIntent/l1LinkFresForHomeRoute/resiliencyFre/l1NcpLinkFres/physicalLinkFres/supportedProtectionFres is used.

Changed: metaDataFields in query

MetaData to be included. The allowed values are: layerRate, layerRateQualifier, signalContentType, serviceClass, sncgUserlabel, adminState, operationState, lqsData.status, lqsData.margin.valid, lqsData.fiber.reconciled, GET /nsi/api/v1/search/fres
Parameters:

Changed: layerRate in query

FRE layer rates in comma separated list The allowed values are: ETHERNET, OTU1, OTU2, OTU2e, OTU3, OTU4, OTUCn, OTSi, OMS, OS, PHY, OTS, FICON, FC, ODU, ODU0, ODU1, ODU2, ODU2e, ODU3, ODU4, ODUCn, DSR, DSR_10GE, DSR_100GE, DSR_ETHERNET, ENCAPSULATION, MPLS, MPLS_PROTECTION, MEDIA, LAG, RS, E1, E3, E1_2M, EC1, DSR_2M, LINE_OC3_STS3_AND_MS_STM1, SECTION_OC3_STS3_AND_RS_STM1, DSR_OC3_STM1, DSR_OC12_STM4, DSR_OC48_STM16, DSR_OC192_STM64, CES_IWF, T1, DSR_1_5M, STS1, STS3C, STS12C, STS24C, STS48C, DS0, DS1, DS3, VT15, VT2, NOT_APPLICABLE, ODUFLEX, OTUg, ODUg, BGP, Flex

Changed: serviceClass in query

(Optional) Allow filtering on the FRE service class. This parameter accepts a list of comma separated values. LLDP has been deprecated. The allowed serviceClass values are: EVC, ETransit, EAccess, VLAN, TDM, Pseudowire Link, Transport Client, Photonic, Tunnel, IP, LLDP, Ethernet, LAG, OTU, ROADM Line, OMS, Fiber, SNC , OSRP Link, OSRP Line, SNCP, ICL, Ring, FlexeLink, FlexeGroup, OTSi, MEDIA, FlexE, L3VPN, BGP Session, Path, EVPN VPWS, EVPN VPWS FXC, ODU, Physical

Changed: supportedByFreId in query

(Optional) Retrieves all supported parent FREs (default is one serviceClass/layer level up) that have a serviceClass designation for the specified list of FRE Id

GET /nsi/api/v2/search/fres
Parameters:

Added: namedQueryParam2 in query

(Optional) can be used with namedQuery fresWithSupportedPWModes in format ncId:pwMode

Changed: layerRate in query

FRE layer rates in comma separated. NA results in all Fres with no layerRate. NOT query is supported. list. The allowed layerRate values are: ETHERNET, OTU1, OTU2, OTU2e, OTU3, OTU4, OTUCn, OTSi, OMS, OS, PHY, OTS, FICON, FC, ODU, ODU0, ODU1, ODU2, ODU2e, ODU3, ODU4, ODUCn, DSR, DSR_10GE, DSR_100GE, DSR_ETHERNET, ENCAPSULATION, MPLS, MPLS_PROTECTION, MEDIA, LAG, RS, E1, E3, E1_2M, EC1, DSR_2M, LINE_OC3_STS3_AND_MS_STM1, SECTION_OC3_STS3_AND_RS_STM1, DSR_OC3_STM1, DSR_OC12_STM4, LINE_OC12_STS12_AND_MS_STM4, SECTION_OC12_STS12_AND_RS_STM4, LINE_OC48_STS48_AND_MS_STM16, SECTION_OC48_STS48_AND_RS_STM16, DSR_OC48_STM16, DSR_OC192_STM64, CES_IWF, T1, DSR_1_5M, STS1, STS3C, STS12C, STS24C, STS48C, STS192C, DS0, DS1, DS3, VT15, VT2, NOT_APPLICABLE, ODUFLEX, OTUg, ODUg, BGP, FLEXE_GROUP, CBR, DSR_FLEXI, XGTC, STS1_50M, DSR_50M, VC4C, VC4_4C, VC4_16C, Flex

Changed: serviceClass in query

(Optional) Allow filtering on the FRE service class. This parameter accepts a list of comma separated values. NA results in all Fres with no serviceClass. NOT query is supported. LLDP has been deprecated. The allowed serviceClass values are: EVC, ETransit, EAccess, VLAN, TDM, Pseudowire Link, Transport Client, Photonic, Tunnel, IP, LLDP, Ethernet, DSR Ethernet, LAG, OTU, ROADM Line, OMS, Fiber, SNC , OSRP Link, OSRP Line, SNCP, ICL, Ring, FlexeLink, FlexeGroup, OTSi, MEDIA, FlexE, L3VPN, BGP Session, Path, EVPN VPWS, PON Link, EVPN VPWS FXC, ODU, Physical,PROTECTED_OMS

Changed: supportedByFreId in query

(Optional) Retrieves all supported parent FREs (default is one serviceClass/layer level up) that have a serviceClass designation for the specified list of FRE Id

Changed: namedQuery in query

(Optional) Comma-separated named query id list; The allowed values are: resiliency, tdmServices, topologicalLinks, roadmLineSpan, reusableSNCG, reusableMRSNCG, reusableNMRSNCG, tunnelReplacement, layer1OtuLinks, photonicSncpWorkLegs, relatedFresFull, relatedFresLight, ringsWithoutConstraints, groupedSNCDTLSET, relatedRoadmlineSeedsForIntent, fresWithSrlg, l1LinkFresForHomeRoute, l1NcpTransportServices, resiliencyFre, fresLookupByName,staticRouteL3VPN, l1NcpLinkFres,eviId,rtList, ebgpL3VPN, layer1LinkConstraints, physicalLinkFres, fresWithSupportedPWModes, fresWithTimeAwareSrlg, supportedProtectionFres

tunnelReplacement cannot be used in combination with other named queries

fresWithSupportedPWModes can be combined with namedQueryParam1 or namedQueryParam2 or both

photonicSncpWorkLegs can not be used alone, networkConstruct.Id must be provided with this named query

relatedFresFull can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

relatedFresLight can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

relatedRoadmlineSeedsForIntent can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query

l1LinkFresForHomeRoute can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query

resiliencyFre can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query

groupedSNCDTLSET cannot be used in combination with other named queries and can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

fresLookupByName can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

staticRouteL3VPN can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

l1NcpLinkFres can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

eviId can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

cfmAdminState can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

rtList can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

ebgpL3VPN can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

physicalLinkFres can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

supportedProtectionFres can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named Query. Provide namedQueryParam1 like {id}...

Changed: namedQueryParam1 in query

Mandatory when namedQuery relatedFresFull/relatedFresLight/relatedRoadmlineSeedsForIntent/l1LinkFresForHomeRoute/resiliencyFre/l1NcpLinkFres/physicalLinkFres/supportedProtectionFres is used.

GET /nsi/api/v3/search/fres
Parameters:

Added: namedQueryParam2 in query

(Optional) can be used with namedQuery fresWithSupportedPWModes in format ncId:pwMode

Changed: layerRate in query

FRE layer rates in comma separated. NA results in all Fres with no layerRate. NOT query is supported. list. The allowed layerRate values are: ETHERNET, OTU1, OTU2, OTU2e, OTU3, OTU4, OTUCn, OTSi, OMS, OS, PHY, OTS, FICON, FC, ODU, ODU0, ODU1, ODU2, ODU2e, ODU3, ODU4, ODUCn, DSR, DSR_10GE, DSR_100GE, DSR_ETHERNET, ENCAPSULATION, MPLS, MPLS_PROTECTION, MEDIA, LAG, RS, E1, E3, E1_2M, EC1, DSR_2M, LINE_OC3_STS3_AND_MS_STM1, SECTION_OC3_STS3_AND_RS_STM1, DSR_OC3_STM1, DSR_OC12_STM4, LINE_OC12_STS12_AND_MS_STM4, SECTION_OC12_STS12_AND_RS_STM4, LINE_OC48_STS48_AND_MS_STM16, SECTION_OC48_STS48_AND_RS_STM16, DSR_OC48_STM16, DSR_OC192_STM64, CES_IWF, T1, DSR_1_5M, STS1, STS3C, STS12C, STS24C, STS48C, STS192C, DS0, DS1, DS3, VT15, VT2, NOT_APPLICABLE, ODUFLEX, OTUg, ODUg, BGP, FLEXE_GROUP, CBR, DSR_FLEXI, XGTC, STS1_50M, DSR_50M VC4, VC4_4C, VC4_16C, Flex

Changed: serviceClass in query

(Optional) Allow filtering on the FRE service class. This parameter accepts a list of comma separated values. NA results in all Fres with no serviceClass. NOT query is supported. LLDP has been deprecated. The allowed serviceClass values are: EVC, ETransit, EAccess, VLAN, TDM, Pseudowire Link, Transport Client, Photonic, Tunnel, IP, LLDP, Ethernet, DSR Ethernet, LAG, OTU, ROADM Line, OMS, Fiber, SNC , OSRP Link, OSRP Line, SNCP, ICL, Ring, FlexeLink, FlexeGroup, OTSi, MEDIA, FlexE, L3VPN, BGP Session, Path, EVPN VPWS, PON Link, EVPN VPWS FXC, ODU, Physical, PROTECTED_OMS

Changed: supportedByFreId in query

(Optional) Retrieves all supported parent FREs (default is one serviceClass/layer level up) that have a serviceClass designation for the specified list of FRE Id

Changed: namedQuery in query

(Optional) Comma-separated named query id list; The allowed values are: resiliency, tdmServices, topologicalLinks, roadmLineSpan, reusableSNCG, reusableMRSNCG, reusableNMRSNCG, tunnelReplacement, layer1OtuLinks, photonicSncpWorkLegs, relatedFresFull, relatedFresLight, ringsWithoutConstraints, groupedSNCDTLSET, relatedRoadmlineSeedsForIntent, fresWithSrlg, l1LinkFresForHomeRoute, l1NcpTransportServices, resiliencyFre, fresLookupByName,staticRouteL3VPN, l1NcpLinkFres,eviId,rtList, ebgpL3VPN, layer1LinkConstraints, physicalLinkFres, fresWithSupportedPWModes, fresWithTimeAwareSrlg, supportedProtectionFres

tunnelReplacement cannot be used in combination with other named queries

Parameters:

Added: pcepManagementType in query

(Optional) Filter SR Policies FRE with pcepManagementType. Possible values ["NA", "PCE-Initiated", "PCC-Delegated"]

Added: namedQueryParam2 in query

(Optional) can be used with namedQuery fresWithSupportedPWModes in format ncId:pwMode

Changed: layerRate in query

FRE layer rates in comma separated. NA results in all Fres with no layerRate. NOT query is supported. list. The allowed layerRate values are: ETHERNET, OTU1, OTU2, OTU2e, OTU3, OTU4, OTUCn, OTSi, OMS, OS, PHY, OTS, FICON, FC, ODU, ODU0, ODU1, ODU2, ODU2e, ODU3, ODU4, ODUCn, DSR, DSR_10GE, DSR_100GE, DSR_ETHERNET, ENCAPSULATION, MPLS, MPLS_PROTECTION, MEDIA, LAG, RS, E1, E3, E1_2M, EC1, DSR_2M, LINE_OC3_STS3_AND_MS_STM1, SECTION_OC3_STS3_AND_RS_STM1, DSR_OC3_STM1, DSR_OC12_STM4, DSR_OC48_STM16, DSR_OC192_STM64, CES_IWF, T1, DSR_1_5M, STS1, STS3C, STS12C, STS24C, STS48C, STS192C, DS0, DS1, DS3, VT15, VT2, NOT_APPLICABLE, ODUFLEX, OTUg, ODUg, BGP, FLEXE_GROUP, CBR, DSR_FLEXI, XGTC, STS1_50M, DSR_50M, Flex

Changed: serviceClass in query

(Optional) Allow filtering on the FRE service class. This parameter accepts a list of comma separated values. NA results in all Fres with no serviceClass. NOT query is supported. LLDP , Fiber and ROADM Line has been deprecated. The allowed serviceClass values are: EVC, ETransit, EAccess, VLAN, TDM, Pseudowire Link, Transport Client, Photonic, Tunnel, IP, LLDP, Ethernet, DSR Ethernet, LAG, OTU, OMS, OTS, SNC , OSRP Link, OSRP Line, SNCP, ICL, Ring, FlexeLink, FlexeGroup, OTSi, MEDIA, FlexE, L3VPN, BGP Session, Path, EVPN VPWS, PON Link, EVPN VPWS FXC, ODU, Physical, PROTECTED_OMS

Changed: supportedByFreId in query

(Optional) Retrieves all supported parent FREs (default is one serviceClass/layer level up) that have a serviceClass designation for the specified list of FRE Id

Changed: namedQuery in query

(Optional) Comma-separated named query id list; The allowed values are: resiliency, tdmServices, topologicalLinks, roadmLineSpan, reusableSNCG, reusableMRSNCG, reusableNMRSNCG, tunnelReplacement, layer1OtuLinks, photonicSncpWorkLegs, relatedFresFull, relatedFresLight, ringsWithoutConstraints, groupedSNCDTLSET, relatedRoadmlineSeedsForIntent, fresWithSrlg, l1LinkFresForHomeRoute, l1NcpTransportServices, resiliencyFre, fresLookupByName,staticRouteL3VPN, l1NcpLinkFres,eviId,rtList, layer1LinkConstraints, physicalLinkFres, fresWithSupportedPWModes, fresWithTimeAwareSrlg, supportedProtectionFres

relatedFresLight can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

GET /nsi/api/v5/search/fres
Parameters:

Added: pcepManagementType in query

(Optional) Filter SR Policies FRE with pcepManagementType. Possible values ["NA", "PCE-Initiated", "PCC-Delegated"]

Added: namedQueryParam2 in query

(Optional) can be used with namedQuery fresWithSupportedPWModes in format ncId:pwMode

Added: endpoint.tpe.shelfNetworkConstruct in query

Comma separated Shelf Network Construct identifier

Changed: layerRate in query

FRE layer rates in comma separated. NA results in all Fres with no layerRate. NOT query is supported. list. The allowed layerRate values are: ETHERNET, OTU1, OTU2, OTU2e, OTU3, OTU4, OTUCn, OTSi, OMS, OS, PHY, OTS, FICON, FC, ODU, ODU0, ODU1, ODU2, ODU2e, ODU3, ODU4, ODUCn, DSR, DSR_10GE, DSR_100GE, DSR_ETHERNET, ENCAPSULATION, MPLS, MPLS_PROTECTION, MEDIA, LAG, RS, E1, E3, E1_2M, EC1, DSR_2M, LINE_OC3_STS3_AND_MS_STM1, SECTION_OC3_STS3_AND_RS_STM1, DSR_OC3_STM1, DSR_OC12_STM4, DSR_OC48_STM16, DSR_OC192_STM64, CES_IWF, T1, DSR_1_5M, STS1, STS3C, STS12C, STS24C, STS48C, STS192C, DS0, DS1, DS3, VT15, VT2, NOT_APPLICABLE, ODUFLEX, OTUg, ODUg, BGP, FLEXE_GROUP, CBR, DSR_FLEXI, PON, STS1_50M, DSR_50M, Flex

Changed: serviceClass in query

(Optional) Allow filtering on the FRE service class. This parameter accepts a list of comma separated values. NA results in all Fres with no serviceClass. NOT query is supported. LLDP , Fiber and ROADM Line has been deprecated. The allowed serviceClass values are: EVC, ETransit, EAccess, VLAN, TDM, Pseudowire Link, Transport Client, Photonic, Tunnel, IP, LLDP, Ethernet, DSR Ethernet, LAG, OTU, OMS, OTS, SNC , OSRP Link, OSRP Line, SNCP, ICL, Ring, FlexeLink, FlexeGroup, OTSi, MEDIA, FlexE, L3VPN, BGP Session, Path, EVPN VPWS, PON Link, EVPN VPWS FXC, ODU, Physical, PROTECTED_OMS

Changed: supportedByFreId in query

(Optional) Retrieves all supported parent FREs (default is one serviceClass/layer level up) that have a serviceClass designation for the specified list of FRE Id

Changed: namedQuery in query

(Optional) Comma-separated named query id list; The allowed values are: resiliency, tdmServices, topologicalLinks, roadmLineSpan, reusableSNCG, reusableMRSNCG, reusableNMRSNCG, tunnelReplacement, layer1OtuLinks, photonicSncpWorkLegs, relatedFresFull, relatedFresLight, ringsWithoutConstraints, groupedSNCDTLSET, relatedRoadmlineSeedsForIntent, fresWithSrlg, l1LinkFresForHomeRoute, l1NcpTransportServices, resiliencyFre, fresLookupByName,staticRouteL3VPN, l1NcpLinkFres,eviId,rtList, layer1LinkConstraints, physicalLinkFres, fresWithSupportedPWModes, fresWithTimeAwareSrlg, supportedProtectionFres

tunnelReplacement cannot be used in combination with other named queries

fresWithSupportedPWModes can be combined with namedQueryParam1 or namedQueryParam2 or both

photonicSncpWorkLegs can not be used alone, networkConstruct.Id must be provided with this named query

relatedFresFull can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

relatedFresLight can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

relatedRoadmlineSeedsForIntent can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query

l1LinkFresForHomeRoute can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query

resiliencyFre can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query

groupedSNCDTLSET cannot be used in combination with other named queries and can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

fresLookupByName can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

staticRouteL3VPN can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

l1NcpLinkFres can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

eviId can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

cfmAdminState can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

rtList can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

physicalLinkFres can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named query.

fresByNcPairs can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named Query. Provide namedQueryParam1 like {neName1&neName2},{neName3&neName4}...

supportedProtectionFres can not be used alone, namedQueryParam1 must be provided with this named Query. Provide namedQueryParam1 like {id}...

Changed: namedQueryParam1 in query

Mandatory when namedQuery relatedFresFull/relatedFresLight/relatedRoadmlineSeedsForIntent/l1LinkFresForHomeRoute/resiliencyFre/l1NcpLinkFres/physicalLinkFres/supportedProtectionFres is used.

Changed: metaDataFields in query

MetaData to be included. The allowed values are: layerRate, layerRateQualifier, signalContentType, serviceClass, sncgUserlabel, adminState, operationState, lqsData.status, lqsData.margin.valid, lqsData.fiber.reconciled, Changed: layerRate in query

(Optional) FRE layer rates in comma separated list. Only applied when Network Construct identifier is provided. The allowed values are: ETHERNET, OTU2, OTU4, OTSi, OMS, OS, PHY, OTS, ODU2, ODU4, DSR, DSR_10GE, DSR_100GE, DSR_ETHERNET, CBR, DSR_FLEXI, Flex

Return Type:

Changed response : 200 OK

GET /nsi/api/v6/fres
Parameters:

Changed: layerRate in query

(Optional) FRE layer rates in comma separated list. Only applied when Network Construct identifier is provided. The allowed values are: ETHERNET, OTU2, OTU4, OTSi, OMS, OS, PHY, OTS, ODU2, ODU4, DSR, DSR_10GE, DSR_100GE, DSR_ETHERNET, CBR, DSR_FLEXI, Flex

Return Type:

Changed response : 200 OK

GET /nsi/api/v9/fres
Parameters:

Changed: layerRate in query

(Optional) FRE layer rates in comma separated list. Only applied when Network Construct identifier is provided. The allowed values are: ETHERNET, OTU2, OTU4, OTSi, OMS, OS, PHY, OTS, ODU2, ODU4, DSR, DSR_10GE, DSR_100GE, DSR_ETHERNET, CBR, DSR_FLEXI, STS1_50M, DSR_50M, STS3C, STS12C, STS48C, VC4, VC4C, VC4_4C, VC4_16C, Flex

Return Type:
